base_row.description: Spectrum TG45SC-E Petrol Scarifier & Aerator - 223cc, 45cm, Electric Key Start
base_row.marketingText: The Spectrum TG45SC-E takes the same 2-in-1 scarifier and aerator platform as our standard TG45SC and adds an electric key-start system - turn a key, the engine fires, you're working. No recoil pull, no wrenched shoulders on a cold morning, no half-dozen attempts when the engine has sat over winter. Key start (with recoil backup) The electric key start is the easiest-to-use ignition on any scarifier in this price band. An on-board battery cranks the engine on demand; a traditional recoil starter is retained as a backup if the battery is flat. Worth the upgrade for anyone with a shoulder, back or grip issue that makes recoil starting a chore - or anyone who simply prefers turning a key over yanking a cord. Two jobs, one machine The TG45SC-E ships with a 45cm scarifier cassette fitted as standard, with an aerator cassette included in the box. Swap cassettes by hand - no tools, no fuss - and you've got a single machine that strips moss and thatch in spring, then opens compacted soil in autumn. Buying separate scarifying and aerating machines costs the best part of a thousand pounds for a comparable specification. 223cc petrol engine The 223cc engine produces 6hp / 4.5kW - enough power to keep the 18 scarifier blades cutting through dense thatch without stalling. Standard unleaded fuel, 3.6-litre tank. Designed for lawns up to 2,000m². Six working-height positions, from -12mm to +10mm A single lever adjusts the cassette height across six positions. Run at -12mm for an aggressive thatch strip, +10mm to lightly tickle the surface of a newer lawn. Adjustability matters most when you're working different lawns or recovering from a bad winter. Blade-engage clutch - leave the engine running A green engagement lever clutches the blades in and out independently of the engine. Stop to empty the 45-litre collector, lift the machine over a path, reposition for a second pass - the engine stays running. Built around a steel deck A pressed steel deck holds the blade shafts in true alignment under load - the single most important thing for cassette life and cutting consistency. Foldable soft-grip handles fold down for storage, and double ball-bearing wheels push smoothly across rough ground. Why buy from 5-year Spectrum warranty (T&C's apply) - supported directly by us, not by a generic distributor UK stock, UK dispatch, UK after-sales Spare parts and service support available throughout the warranty period

True 2-in-1 machine — interchangeable scarifier and aerator cassettes both included
223cc 4-stroke petrol engine, 6hp / 4.5kW — power to keep 18 blades cutting through heavy thatch without stalling
45cm working width covering lawns up to 2,000m²
Six working-height positions from -12mm to +10mm via a single adjustment lever
Blade-engage clutch — empty the collector or lift over a path without restarting the engine
Pressed steel deck holds blade shafts in alignment under load, where plastic decks warp
45-litre debris collector with the option to run open for bulk-clearing heavy thatch
Foldable soft-grip handles and double ball-bearing wheels for comfortable use and compact storage
